rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the middle of the night rather than an exactly stated clock time.

example.english: I’m still not asleep at midnight, and I have work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 半夜我仲未瞓，聽日仲要返工。
example.jyutping: bun3 je6 ngo5 zung6 mei6 fan3 ting1 jat6 zung6 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this phrase when you need to specify exactly twelve o'clock at night.

example.english: We don’t finish work until midnight, so we’re really tired.
example.traditional: 半夜十二點先收工，真係攰。
example.jyutping: bun3 je6 sap6 ji6 dim2 sin1 sau1 gung1 zan1 hai6 gui6
